title: 第11章  考军校！林国栋同意了？
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
不过，唯一让林毅有点拿不准的，就是自己还没激活的系统。
不知道考军校、走军官路线，能不能激活系统？
【叮！】
【检测到宿主核心目标：报考军校。】
【符合系统激活前置要求！】
【考上军校即视为入伍，将全面激活系统！】
听到系统的提示，林毅眼睛放光，差点没忍住笑出声。
“那就没得说了。”
“这个军校，老子必考上！”
“国栋啊国栋，我倒要看看，你这次还怎么拦我！”
第二天清晨，天刚蒙蒙亮。
准六点，林毅的眼睛准时睁开，一秒清醒，不带半点拖沓。
他翻身下床，习惯性抻平床单、捋顺边角，双手利落翻飞，三两下就将被子叠得方方正正、棱角分明，标准的豆腐块整整齐齐摆在床头。
收拾完内务，他随手换上昨天的作训服。
林毅推门出门，直奔小区内的跑道。
五公里啊，我爱你啊！
一天一个，加把劲啊！
五公里啊，真有力啊！
一天不跑，想死你啊！
林毅脑海中自动播放着口号，围着跑道匀速跑着。

此时的林家餐厅，一家三口早已落座吃早饭。
王秀兰一早就看到儿子出门跑步了，趁着爷俩都在这，轻声开口：“看来儿子是真铁了心想回部队啊。”
坐在对面的林国栋闻言，当即冷哼一声：“哼，什么真心实意，我看他就是故意做做样子给我们看的！”
他放下碗筷，满脸了然：“我是他老子，我比谁都了解他。”
“这小子从小就鬼点子多，他就是在报复我跟爸，就是怨恨我跟爸当年非要把他送到部队里去！”
“我把话放这，就算真让他如愿回了部队，用不了多久，他绝对又要闹退伍！”
“到时候三进三出变四进四出，我和爸这张老脸，就彻底在部队里丢得一干二净了，要是真那样，我干脆也退伍算了！”
一旁的林建军听完两人对话，气的哼了一声，果断起身背着手回到了房间。
很显然，老爷子对这件事也非常的生气。
跑步结束。
林毅抱着一整套全新的高中全科教材、教辅资料，慢悠悠踱步回家。
刚回到家，王秀兰见状顿时一愣，连忙起身走上前：“儿子，你手里抱的这是什么啊？”
“高中全套教材。”林毅随手将书本放在茶几上，“后天才能去学校正式报到，这两天总不能在家浪费时间，我先自学两天，提前熟悉熟悉知识点，找找读书的状态。”
军校录取分数线可不是闹着玩的，竞争大、门槛高，半点水都摸不得。
自己六年没碰书本，知识点早就断层，教材也全部更新换代，要是不提前发力、认真备考，那属于是白日做梦。
想绕开家里的阻拦、稳稳考上军校激活系统、重回军营，唯一的出路就是刷题备考，卷出高分来。
好在他高中时学习就不差，想要重新捡起来，应该还是比较容易的。
王秀兰看着满满一摞崭新的书本，看着儿子难得上进的模样，眼底溢满欣慰的笑意，连忙叮嘱：“好好好，我儿子长大了，但是也别太拼，别太累着自己，劳逸结合。”
“放心吧妈，我有数。”
林毅咧嘴一笑，抱着书本就回了房间。

接下来的两天，林毅彻底收心，把自己关在房间里闭门自学。
书桌摊满了崭新的高中教材和教辅资料，曾经烂熟于心的知识点，时隔六年再翻回来，不能说太陌生，只能说是完全看不懂，跟天书没什么区别。
毕竟他十八岁奔赴军营，六年扎根训练场、摸爬滚打，天天打交道的是战术、体能、装备和口令，早就和书本知识彻底脱节了。
再加上这些年教材迭代更新，考点、题型、知识点改动极大，很多内容他压根闻所未闻。
密密麻麻的公式、文言文、数理逻辑，看得他头大无比。
果然还是得结合老师的讲解啊……自学只能当做是熟悉。
不过只要能熟悉一下也就够了，反正等开学后，有的是老师讲解的时候。
就是希望到时候李舒婉别给自己穿小鞋就行了。
一想起那个有病的女人，林毅暗道一声“晦气”，继续投身到书本的海洋之中。
两天闭关刷题的日子转瞬即逝，转眼就到了周一，正式入校报到的日子。
按照学校最新规定，新的一年新学期全员开启军训模式，覆盖全校所有年级，不光高一新生，高二高三老生就连复读班也无一例外，全部统一军训、统一住校封闭管理。
这条新规还是爷爷那位老战友、现任校长大力推行的。
老爷子深耕教育多年，一直坚信少年当有血性、体魄需先锤炼，特意新增全校军训制度，哪怕是冲刺高考的复读生，也必须先过军训这关，磨砺心性、淬炼自律。
也正因如此，林毅这次复读必须住校，压根没有走读的余地。
一大早，王秀兰就忙前忙后，把行李箱塞得满满当当。
被褥、衣物、洗漱用品、常备药品、零食水果，大大小小物件一应俱全，恨不得把半个家都塞进箱子里。
林毅看着那只鼓鼓囊囊、快合不上的行李箱，眼角抽了一下，一脸无奈地开口：“妈，没必要吧？东西也太多了，我就是去学校住校复读，不是去校外春游露营，真用不上这么多。”
他在部队六年，早就习惯了极简内务，行囊从简、干净利落，随身物品屈指可数。
看着这满满一箱琐碎物件，只觉得繁琐累赘，浑身不自在。
一旁的林国栋坐在沙发上，冷眼旁观全程，闻言当即冷哼一声：“你这到底是让他去住校读书，还是送小孩子出去春游郊游？矫揉造作，惯得没样子！”

王秀兰当即回头瞪了他一眼：“你懂个屁！孩子六年没回校园读书，第一次住校，方方面面都得用到，多备点怎么了？总比到时候缺这少那、没人照应强。”
被老婆当众反驳，林国栋哑口无言，懒得继续掰扯，索性起身转身走开，眼不见心不烦。
林毅看着老妈细致妥帖的准备，有点哭笑不得。
他太了解自家老妈的性子，永远把孩子当成长不大的小孩，事事操心、面面俱到。
当年自己要去部队的时候，老妈哭的跟泪人似的，给自己准备了整整三个大行李箱，里面全是各种吃的，用的，甚至就连卫生巾都准备好了。
就是因为听人说训练太苦了，把卫生巾垫在膝盖跟鞋里会比较舒服。
最后还是因为老爸说，准备这么多也没用，到了部队也就收缴了，老妈这才放弃了。
可这次，学校肯定不会收缴行李物品的……
他干脆抬手接过行李箱，随口说道：“行了妈，我知道你心疼我，这些我都带上，时间不早了，我得走了，去晚了该赶不上报到了。”
临行前，王秀兰还是忍不住再三叮嘱，语气满是温柔心疼：“儿子，到了学校好好适应，学习也别逼自己太紧。”
“要是真觉得太累、学不进去，咱们就不学了，回家好好休息也行，别熬坏身体。”
军训她是一点都不担心，儿子好歹也是当了六年兵，一个小小的军训算什么。
搞不好儿子还比教官军龄长呢，唯独就是学习的苦，实在是太累人了。
林毅抬手拎起沉重的行李箱，笃定道：“放心吧妈，我心里有数，绝对没问题。”
这一年复读，他势在必得，军校，他志在必取！
他刚走出门，就见站在门口的林国栋冷冷的瞥了他一眼：“你是真心想重回部队？”
content_en:
However, the only thing that makes Ji Yi a little unsure is the system that he has not activated yet.
I wonder if I can activate the system if I take the military academy exam or take the officer route?
【bite! 】
[Host core target detected: apply for military academy. 】
[Meet the prerequisites for system activation! 】
[Admission to the military academy is deemed to be enlistment, and the system will be fully activated! 】
Hearing the system prompts, Ji Yi's eyes lit up and he almost couldn't hold back his laughter.
"Then there's nothing to say."
"I must pass the exam at this military academy!"
"Guodong, Guodong, I want to see how you can stop me this time!"
The next morning, it was just dawn.
Exactly six o'clock, Ji Yi's eyes opened on time, and he was awake for a second without any delay.
He rolled over and got out of bed, habitually straightening the sheets and smoothing the corners. His hands flew neatly and in a few clicks, he folded the quilt into a square shape with sharp edges. Standard tofu cubes were neatly placed at the head of the bed.
After cleaning up the house, he casually changed into yesterday's training uniform.
Ji Yi opened the door and went straight to the running track in the community.
Five kilometers, I love you!
One day, keep working harder!
Five kilometers, so powerful!
If I don’t run for a day, I will miss you to death!
The slogan automatically played in Ji Yi's mind and he ran around the track at a constant speed.
At this time, the Lin family restaurant, a family of three, had already sat down to have breakfast.
Wang Xiulan saw her son going out for a run early in the morning. While both fathers were here, she said softly: "It seems that my son is really determined to return to the army."
When Lin Guodong, who was sitting opposite, heard this, he immediately snorted: "Humph, what's sincere? I think he's just pretending to show it to us!"
He put down the bowl and chopsticks with a clear face: "I am his father, and I know him better than anyone else."
"This kid has been full of tricks since he was a child. He just wants to take revenge on me and dad. He just resents me and dad for having to send him to the army!"
"Let me put it this way, even if he does return to the army as he wishes, it won't be long before he will definitely be discharged again!"
"When the three-in-three-out becomes four-in and four-out, dad and I will be completely disgraced in the army with our old faces. If that happens, I might as well quit the army!"
After listening to the conversation between the two, Lin Jianjun on the side snorted angrily, stood up decisively, and returned to the room with his hands behind his back.
Obviously, the old man was also very angry about this matter.
The run is over.
Lin Yi walked home slowly holding a set of brand-new high school textbooks and teaching aids.
As soon as she returned home, Wang Xiulan was stunned when she saw this, and quickly stood up and walked forward: "Son, what is this in your hand?"
"A complete set of high school textbooks." Lin Yi casually put the book on the coffee table. "I can't officially register at school until the day after tomorrow. I can't waste time at home these two days. I'll study by myself for two days first, familiarize myself with the knowledge points in advance, and find myself in a state of study."
The admission score of military academies is no joke. The competition is fierce, the threshold is high, and you can’t even touch it.
I haven't touched a book in six years, so my knowledge has long been broken, and all the textbooks have been updated. If I don't work hard in advance and prepare carefully for the exam, it will be a daydream.
If you want to get around the obstacles at home, get into the military academy, activate the system, and return to the military camp, the only way out is to prepare for the exam and get high scores.
Fortunately, he was not bad at studying in high school, so it should be relatively easy to pick it up again.
Wang Xiulan looked at a stack of brand-new books and saw her son's rare progress. Her eyes were filled with a happy smile, and she quickly warned: "Okay, okay, my son has grown up, but don't work too hard, don't tire yourself too much, and balance work with rest."
"Don't worry, Mom, I know."
Ji Yi grinned, hugged the book and returned to the room.
In the next two days, Ji Yi completely calmed down and locked himself in his room to study on his own.
The desk is covered with brand-new high school textbooks and teaching aids. The knowledge points that I once knew by heart are still unfamiliar to me when I come back to them after six years.I can only say that I can't understand it at all. It's no different from a heavenly book.
After all, he went to the military camp at the age of eighteen, spent six years in the training ground, and worked hard. He dealt with tactics, physical fitness, equipment, and commands every day. He had long been completely out of touch with book knowledge.
In addition, the textbooks have been updated iteratively over the years, and the test points, question types, and knowledge points have changed greatly. Many of the contents have never been heard of.
The dense formulas, classical Chinese, and mathematical logic made his head feel dizzy.
Sure enough, you still have to combine the teacher's explanation... Self-study can only be regarded as familiarity.
But it’s enough to get familiar with it. After school starts, there will be plenty of time for the teacher to explain it.
I just hope that Li Shuwan won't put on small shoes for herself when the time comes.
Thinking of the sick woman, Lin Yi secretly said "bad luck" and continued to plunge into the ocean of books.
The two days of retreat to study questions passed by in a blink of an eye, and it was Monday, the day to officially register for school.
According to the latest regulations of the school, all students will start military training in the new year and new semester, covering all grades in the school. Not only the freshmen, but also the senior students in the second and third grade, and even the repeat students. All students will have unified military training and unified dormitory closed management.
This new rule was vigorously promoted by my grandfather’s old comrade-in-arms and current principal.
The old man has been deeply engaged in education for many years and has always believed that young people must be strong-willed and physical. He has specially added a military training system for the whole school. Even the repeat students who are preparing for the college entrance examination must first pass the military training to sharpen their mind and temper their self-discipline.
Because of this, Lin Yi must live on campus this time to repeat his studies, and there is no room for day study.
Early in the morning, Wang Xiulan was busy stuffing her suitcase full.
Bedding, clothing, toiletries, regular medicines, snacks and fruits, all large and small items are all available. I wish I could stuff half of my house into the box.
Ji Yi looked at the bulging suitcase that could hardly be closed. His eyes twitched and he said helplessly: "Mom, it's not necessary, right? There are too many things. I just go to school to live in school and repeat my studies. I'm not going to go out for spring outings and camping. I really don't need so much."
He has been in the army for six years and has long been accustomed to minimalist housekeeping. His luggage is simple, clean and neat, and he only has a handful of belongings.
Looking at this box full of trivial items, I just felt cumbersome and uneasy.
Lin Guodong was sitting on the sofa beside him, watching the whole process with cold eyes. After hearing this, he immediately snorted: "Are you going to let him live in school to study, or are you sending the child out for a spring outing? It's so pretentious, so spoiled!"
Wang Xiulan immediately turned back and glared at him: "You know what the hell! My child hasn't been back to school for six years. It's his first time living on campus. He has to use everything. What's wrong with having more preparations? It's better than being short of this and that and having no one to take care of him."
Being rebutted by his wife in public, Lin Guodong was speechless and too lazy to continue arguing. He simply stood up and walked away, out of sight and out of mind.
Lin Yi looked at his mother's meticulous preparations and felt a little dumbfounded.
He understands his mother's temperament very well, and always treats his children as little grown-up children, worrying about everything and taking care of everything.
When I was going to the army, my mother cried like a woman and prepared three large suitcases for herself, filled with all kinds of food and supplies, even sanitary napkins.
It’s because I heard people say that training is too hard, so it would be more comfortable to put sanitary napkins in your knees and shoes.
In the end, my mother gave up because my father said that it was useless to prepare so much and they would be confiscated when they arrived at the army.
But this time, the school will definitely not confiscate luggage items...
He simply raised his hand to take the suitcase and said casually: "Okay, Mom, I know you feel sorry for me, so I'll take all these with me. It's getting late, I have to leave. If I go late, I'll miss my registration."
Before leaving, Wang Xiulan couldn't help but warn her again and again, her tone full of tenderness and distress: "Son, get used to it well when you get to school.Don’t push yourself too hard when studying. "
"If you really feel too tired and can't study, we won't study. You can just go home and have a good rest. Don't wear out your body. "
She was not worried about military training at all. Her son had been a soldier for six years after all, so a small military training was nothing.
Maybe my son is older than the instructor, but the hard work is just too tiring.
Ji Yi raised his hand to pick up the heavy suitcase and said firmly: "Don't worry, Mom, I know what's going on, there's absolutely no problem. "
If he repeats his studies this year, he is bound to get it. In the military academy, he is determined to get it!
As soon as he walked out of the door, he saw Lin Guodong standing at the door and glanced at him coldly: "Do you really want to return to the army? "
